name: MySQL
description: Advanced open-source relational database server from Oracle.
longDescription: MySQL Server is a widely used relational database. DevForge installs Oracle's official Windows MSI through WinGet and verifies the Windows service and client. Credential setup is your responsibility; DevForge never stores or logs database passwords.
caveats: This is a database server. Installation requires administrator permission and Microsoft Visual C++ redistributables.
DevForge does not create, store or log database passwords. Rotate or configure the root account securely after installation.
MySQL is installed with the vendor's Developer preset via WinGet. Review the generated configuration before exposing the server to a network.
Uninstalling does not delete your data directory. Back up your databases before removing the server.
